column1: 咱们每个人轮流吟诗一首，不过略去其中的一句。\n若能答上来便算过关，若答不上，罚酒一杯便是！
column2: We will take turns reciting a poem, but we will omit one line each.\nIf you can answer correctly, you pass. If not, you'll have to drink a cup!

column1: 咳咳...咳咳...这腊八粥味道着实有些奇怪，\n只能说食之无味，弃之可惜。
column2: Cough... cough... This Laba porridge really tastes strange,\nIt's a waste to eat, yet throwing it away is a pity.

column1: 咳咳咳...不知为何，一吃下这药就觉得头晕恶心，身体不适。\n算了算了，我还是另请高明吧。
column2: Cough cough cough... For some reason, I feel dizzy and queasy after taking this medicine, and my body isn't feeling well.\nWell, I'll just have to hire someone else then.

column1: 咳咳咳...不知为何，忽觉头晕恶心，身体不适。\n我回去休息片刻，先行告辞。
column2: Cough cough cough... For some reason, I suddenly feel dizzy, nauseous, and unwell.\nI will go back and rest for a moment before taking my leave.

column1: 哈哈哈哈，仙居客栈一战，乃是我逆转周天大法散功之际，这才让你占了便宜。\n今天，我功力大成，便要打到你们心服口服为止！
column2: Haha, the battle at the Xianju Inn was when I was reversing my Tranquil Heaven Technique and losing power. That's how you got the upper hand.\nToday, with my power fully unleashed, I shall fight until you submit!

column1: 哈哈我这药方果然没问题，你有没有感觉龙精虎猛，浑身都是力气？
column2: Haha, my remedy really works. Do you feel dragon fierce and tiger strong, with lots of energy all over your body?

column1: 哈哈，免礼免礼。不知阁下远道而来，有何贵干啊？
column2: Haha, no need for formalities. I wonder what brings you all the way here?

column1: 哈哈，多谢大人。我必当竭尽所能，尽忠效力！
column2: Ha ha, thank you, Lord. I will surely serve with dedication and loyalty. strive to serve you wholeheartedly!

column1: 哈哈，如此甚好，我这就去将此秘籍参悟修习一番，先行告辞了！
column2: Ha ha, that's excellent. I'll go meditate and practice this secret technique right away. I'll be going now!

column1: 哈哈，少侠不辞辛苦，寻来到这荒郊陋室，想必是有事相求。\n既然你我有缘，尽管开口，若能办得到，我一定竭力相助。
column2: Haha, Young Hero, you've come all this way to this desolate hut without complaint, so there must be something you need.\nSince we are destined to meet, just speak up. If it is within my power, I will certainly do my best to assist you.

column1: 哈哈，师傅说的是。\n我们这次便联手烹饪这道腊八粥，看看最后究竟滋味如何。
column2: Haha, Master is right\nLet's collaborate to cook this Laba porridge and see how it turns out.

column1: 哈哈，徒儿们都到了吗？难得我们师徒齐聚一堂，共度中秋。\n看你们兴高采烈的样子，为师也深感欣慰。
column2: Haha, have all my disciples arrived? It's rare for us master-disciple to gather like this to celebrate Mid-Autumn together.\nSeeing your joy, my master is also greatly pleased.

column1: 哈哈，您老人家一向乐善好施，慷慨大方，江湖中谁人不知谁人不晓，\n这大过年的，自然也会对徒儿倍加关爱，包一个大红包以示鼓励。
column2: Ha ha, your honor has always been generous and kind-hearted. Who in the Jianghu doesn't know of it?\nDuring the Spring Festival, he would naturally show even greater care for his apprentice and give a big red envelope as a sign of encouragement.

column1: 哈哈，明月几时有，把酒问青天，\n没答上来的人，都罚酒，罚酒！
column2: Haha, when will the bright moon appear? I raise a cup to ask the blue sky.\nThose who didn't answer get punished with a drink!

column1: 哈哈，猜中了猜中了！\n今日得见两位高手过招，着实令我眼界大开。
column2: Haha, you guessed it right!\nToday getting to see two masters go head to head truly broadened my horizons.

column1: 哈哈，这些镖银本大爷就笑纳了！
column2: Haha, I'll gladly accept these gold ingots!

column1: 哈哈，那我就不客气咯......\n嗯，饼皮香韧，馅料充实，软糯可口，奇香扑鼻，\n咱们仙霞派的金牌大厨，手艺是越来越好了！
column2: Ha ha, then I won't be so polite...\nMmm, the pastry is crisp and tender, the filling is generous and soft, making it delightful to eat, and the aroma is exceptionally fragrant.\nOur top chef from the Xianxia Sect has gotten even better at cooking!

column1: 哈哈，都来了吗？\n难得徒儿们济济一堂，共度春节，为师也是打心眼里高兴啊。
column2: Haha, are you all here?\nIt's rare for my disciples to gather together to celebrate the Spring Festival. I'm genuinely delighted.

column1: 哎呀呀，新婚之夜却醉成这个样子，都让你少喝点了。\n来吧我扶你躺着去。
column2: Oh well, you ended up drunk on your wedding night, even though I made you have less to drink.\nCome on, I'll help you lie down

column1: 哎呀哎呀，如此心意我也不便推辞，\n日后定要当面答谢贵掌门一番才是。
column2: Ah ah, I cannot refuse such kind intentions either.\nWe must thank the Sect Leader in person another day.

column1: 哎呀！可我没准备礼物，怎么办怎么办......
column2: Oh no! But I didn't prepare a gift, what should I do...

column1: 哎呀，几位掌门！我郭淮行走江湖多年，从未因收受好处而做过什么违心之举。\n各位，请相信我啊！别再争了！
column2: Ah, several Sect Leaders! I, Guo Huai, have wandered the Jianghu for many years and have never done anything against my conscience for any benefits.\nGuys, please believe me! Stop arguing!

column1: 哎哟，多谢多谢。\n这年头像少侠如此心善之人，已经不多见了。\n既然如此，我便送你去一个好地方吧...
column2: Oh, thank you very much\nThese days, it's not easy to see a hero like you who is so kind.\nThen I'll send you to a good place...

column1: 哎，以往都是师傅给我们发红包，\n只可惜如今他老人家已经不在......
column2: Ah, in the past, it was always Master who sent us red envelopes,\nSadly, he is no longer with us now...
Ah, just a little bit more

column1: 哎，我早就劝你少做些离经叛道之事。\n你看，果不其然，被人抓入牢中了吧！
column2: Ah, I had advised you to do fewer outrageous things long ago.\nSure enough, you were caught and thrown into prison!

column1: 哎，真的是一群吃货，\n值此皓月当空，良辰美景，你们却只知道吃月饼？
column2: Oh, they are truly a bunch of food lovers.\nWith the bright moon shining, this perfect time, all you know is eating mooncakes?

column1: 哎，真的是一群吃货，\n值此皓月当空，良辰美景，你们还是只知道吃月饼。
column2: Oh, they are truly a bunch of food lovers.\nOn this full moon with perfect weather, you still just know how to eat mooncakes.

column1: 哎，若之前欧庄主能给我足够材料，此神兵或许可以更为强大。\n不过如今能有这种结果，我也算心满意足了。
column2: Ah, if Manor Master had provided me with sufficient materials earlier, this divine weapon might have been even stronger.\nBut to have this result now, I can say I am content.

column1: 哎，讨债失败了......\n为今之计，要么自己把钱垫付上，要么只能放弃委托了。
column2: Sigh, failed to collect the debt.....\nFor now, we either have to cover the expenses ourselves, or we have to abandon the commission.

column1:
哎，这几位眷侣整日争风吃醋，往来应付已是疲惫不堪。
干脆携手一同归隐江湖，去享受风花雪月的二人...六人世界好了。

Ah, these couple companions are constantly jealous of each other. Dealing with it day in and day out leaves them exhausted.
Why not retire together into the Jianghu and enjoy the world of wind, flowers, snow, and moon for just the two of us... or six of us.

column1: 哟呵，还以为是什么神兵利器，原来只是堆破铜烂铁而已！\n敢在老子的地盘上招摇撞骗，活腻了是吧！
column2: Oh, I thought it was some divine weapon, but turns out it's just a pile of scrap metal!\nDare to pull off scams on my territory? Had enough of living, huh!

column1: 哦，这腊八粥香气浓郁，滋味甜美，\n时人称之滋补佳品，确实实至名归！
column2: Oh, this Laba porridge has a rich aroma and a sweet taste.\nIt is indeed fitting that it is hailed as a superior tonic!

column1: 哪来不长眼的毛头小子，竟然敢闯咱们山寨送死？\n弟兄们，给我细细切做臊子！
column2: Where did this reckless youngster come from, daring to intrude upon our mountain stronghold and seek death?\nBrothers, cut it finely for the stew!

column1: 哼哼，只需在这些城墙工事上动些手脚......
column2: Hmph, just tamper with these fortifications...

column1: 哼哼，怕不又是些师叔师祖传下来的的破铜烂铁老物件，\n送去当铺都没人收。
column2: Hmph, it's probably just some old junk passed down by Master Uncles and Ancestors.\nNo one will accept it at the pawnshop.

column1: 哼哼，承让承让！\n既然是在下小胜一筹，那这宝藏我便全数笑纳了。
column2: Hmph, it's a fair fight!\nSince I have come out slightly inferior, I shall humbly accept all of the treasure.

column1: 哼哼，来得正好，你们这些年轻人啊，\n饱食终日，不务正事，四体不勤，五谷不分，\n倒是正应该多来听听我讲经说法。
column2: Hmph, you're just in time, you youngsters\nEating to one's heart's content all day long, neglecting one's duties, idle and unproductive, ignorant of the five grains.\nYou should actually come more often to hear me preach.

column1: 哼哼，皆是些虚名而已。\n不过能在这荒山野岭相遇，你我也算有些缘分。
column2: Hmph, all mere empty titles\nBut to meet each other in these remote hills and valleys, you and I must have some destiny.

column1: 哼哼，看在我今天心情不错的份上，这次就放你一马，快滚吧！
column2: Hmph, considering my good mood today, I'll let you off this time. Go on, get lost!

column1: 哼哼，看在这些银子的份上，这次就放你一马，快滚吧！
column2: Hmph, considering this silver, I'll let you off this time. Go, go, go!

column1: 哼！一屋不扫，何以扫天下，你既然不肯，我差遣其他弟子去便是。
column2: Hmph! If you can't clean your own room, how can you clean the world? Since you won't do it, I'll send other disciples to do it instead.

column1: 哼！不学无术，噩噩浑浑，若是再这样荒废下去，为师就要罚你面壁思过去了！
column2: Hmph! Without learning, just muddling through-If you keep wasting your time like this, I'm going to make you sit in the corner and reflect!

column1: 哼！就这点三脚猫功夫，也敢学别人拦路打劫？\n还不快滚，别让我再碰上你！
column2: Hmph! With just this mediocre skill, you dare to imitate bandits and hold up others on the road?\nHurry up and get out of here before I run into you again!

column1: 哼！就这点三脚猫功夫，也敢来入室打劫？\n来人呐，快把这恶贼绑了！
column2: Hmph! With just this meager skill, you dare to break into someone's home to rob them?\nCome quickly and tie up this evil bandit!

column1: 哼，以后不许再随意诋毁我们家雪儿，听见了没有！
column2: Hmph, you're not allowed to casually insult Xue'er again. Do you hear me!

column1: 哼，别再让我看见你，快滚吧！
column2: Hmph, don't let me see you again. Get out!

column1: 哼，就凭阁下的武功，恐怕想挑战还为时尚早吧！
column2: Hmph. With your martial arts skills, you're probably too early to challenge me!

column1: 哼，我早就预料到会有这天，无妨。\n如今天下大半已在我手，剩下的不过是些散兵游勇，不足为虑。
column2: Hmph, I suspected this day would come, no harm done.\nNow that the majority of the land is in my hands, the remaining are mere stragglers, worthy of no concern.

column1: 哼，既然如此我也别无选择，花钱消灾便是了，告辞！
column2: Hm, since that's the case, I have no other choice but to spend money to avoid trouble. Goodbye!

column1: 哼，狗贼，别让我再看见你，否则定不轻饶！
column2: Hmph, dog traitor. Don't let me catch you again or I won't spare you.

column1: 哼，真是废了不少功夫。\n江湖凶险，下辈子投个好胎去吧，受死！
column2: Hmph, it took a lot of effort\nJianghu is treacherous; may you find a better rebirth next time! Die!

column1: 哼，算你识相，东西留下，人快滚吧。\n今天爷心情好，饶你一条狗命！
column2: Hmph, you're not completely useless. Keep what you've stolen, and get out of here quickly.\nToday, Lord, I'm in a good mood and I'll spare your life!

column1: 哼，那咱们大不了改日再见分晓，各位告辞！
column2: Hmph. In that case, we can settle it another day. Goodbye, everyone!

column1: 唔...啊...完全没感觉啊...再使点劲！
column2: Ugh... Ah... Nothing at all... Apply a bit more force!

column1: 唔啊............\n(要害中招，毙命当场)
column2: Ugh............\n(Vital Point hit, died on the spot)

column1: 唔！......愿赌服输，咱们后会有期！
column2: Ah!... Fair is fair, let's meet again another time!

column1: 唔！没想到半路杀出个程咬金，吃我这招......三十六计走为上！
column2: Oh! Didn't expect a Cheng Yaojin to show up out of nowhere. Here, I'll use this strategy... Fleeing is the best option in this situation!

column1: 唔！没想到这群官府走狗还有两下子，看来只能先行撤退，再从长计议！
column2: Ah! I didn't expect these officials to have any skill. Looks like we'll have to retreat first and plan our next move carefully!

column1: 唔！贼人势大，眼看抵挡不住。\n大侠你先行逃开，我自有脱身之手段！
column2: Ah! The bandits are powerful; it looks like we can't hold them off.\nGreat Hero, you go and escape first; I have my own way to extricate myself!

column1: 唔！贼人势大，眼看抵挡不住。\n小兄弟你先行逃开，我自有脱身之手段！
column2: Ah! The bandits are powerful; it looks like we can't hold them off.\nLittle Brother, you go and escape first; I have my own way to extricate myself!

column1: 唔，打也打不过，跑也跑不掉。\n事到如今，也只剩拼命一法了！
column2: Well, we can't beat them in a fight, and we can't outrun them either.\nNow that we've come this far, we can only fight with everything we have!

column1: 唔，贼人来势汹汹，此地不宜久留，先走为妙！
column2: Well, the bandits are advancing rapidly. It's not wise to stay here. We'd better leave quickly!

column1: 唔，这家伙发起狠来，倒真有几分难缠。\n势头不妙，还是先开溜吧！
column2: Well, this guy can be quite tenacious when he really puts his mind to it.\nThe situation isn't good, better to escape first!

column2: Ah... But the antithesis and atmosphere just don't quite feel right.\nI'll ask someone else......

column1: 啊呀呀，少侠想要在本店举办宴会？那可真是欢迎之至！\n举办宴会可以吸引周遭声望相近的武林人士前来参与，一道把酒言欢。\n宴会评分越高，客人的身份也会越尊贵，增进的好感自然也越多。
column2: Ah, Young Hero, you wish to hold a banquet in this establishment? That is most welcome!\nHosting a banquet can attract nearby Wulin individuals with similar reputations, allowing you to share a few drinks and good conversations together.\nThe higher the rating of the banquet, the more prestigious the guests will be, naturally increasing goodwill.

column1: 啊啊啊啊啊啊！\n明明藏得这么好，怎么还是被发现了？\n快给我拿下了此人，本官重重有赏！
column2: Ah ah ah ah ah ah!\nIt's clearly hidden so well, how did it get discovered anyway?\nHurry up and take down this person; I will reward you handsomely!

column1: 啊这......看来只好另寻他人了......
column2: Ah well... it seems I'll have to find someone else...

column1: 啊这......附近竟无人参加宴会吗？\n可惜浪费了一桌好酒好菜啊......
column2: Oh, come on......There's not a single person nearby attending the banquet?\nToo bad all that good food and wine went to waste......
Oh well... off I go then.;GiveUpPerformForMoney

column1: 啊？几位，慢着慢着慢着！\n你们来真的啊？还请听我解释啊！！！\n(完了完了，若非此前三心二意，又怎会落入今日之修罗场)
column2: Oh? Hold on, hold on, hold on!\nYou're serious? Let me explain!!!\n(Done and done. If I hadn't been distracted these past few days, how could I have ended up in this hellish situation today?)

column1: 啊？还有这等好事？\n既然老先生这么说，那我就不客气了！
column2: Ah? Such good fortune?\nSince the elder says so, I won't be polite!

column1: 嗯...这腊八粥口味适中，无功无过，\n不过也足以暖胃果腹了。
column2: Hmm... This mung bean porridge is moderately flavored, neither particularly excellent nor entirely lacking.\nBut it's enough to warm the stomach and fill the belly.

column1: 嗯，不过为师一看，门内似乎没有适合进行考核的人选。\n眼下本门正值用人之际，就破例允许你直接晋升好了。
column2: Hmm, but Master, upon inspection, it seems there are no suitable candidates within the sect for the evaluation.\nThe guild is currently in need of people, so we can allow you to advance directly.

column1: 嗯，你这家伙倒也颇为识相。\n好，看在你一片心意的份上，我就收下了。
column2: Well, you're not entirely hopeless, I suppose\nAlright, since you're being so sincere, I'll accept it.

column1: 嗯，看在你态度诚恳的份上，\n这些赔礼我会代为转交的。
column2: Well, considering your sincere attitude,\nI will see to it that the apologies are conveyed.

column1: 嗯，看来徒儿果真有些心得。\n这收集银钱之事，只需去本门的钱庄中经营几日，想来不难完成。
column2: Hmm, it seems the disciple truly has some insights.\nThis matter of collecting silver, we only need Go operate in the door's bank for a few days., It shouldn't be difficult to accomplish

column1: 嘿嘿，官爷，在下已苦居狱中多日，\n近来身体越发不适，还望您能请位大夫来替我诊治一番。\n这些银子作为诊费，想必应该足够了吧。
column2: Hehe, Lord, your humble servant has been in prison for many days.\nLately, I have been feeling increasingly unwell. I hope you can have a doctor come to treat me.\nThese silver coins should cover the doctor's fee, I presume.

column1: 嘿嘿，官爷，近来劳烦您看顾了。\n在下这儿正好有些银两，区区小礼不成敬意。\n您只管拿去，和弟兄们买些好酒好肉吃。
column2: Hehe, Sir Governor, you've been taking care of me lately.\nI happen to have some silver here, a small gift to show my respect.\nTake it and buy some good wine and meat for the brothers to enjoy.

column1: 嘿嘿，官爷，近来劳烦您看顾了。\n在下这儿正好有些银两，想劳烦你交给此前被我挑战之人，作为赔礼。
column2: Hehe, Sir Governor, you've been taking care of me lately.\nI happen to have some silver here, and I would like you to deliver it to the person I challenged previously, as a token of apology.

column1: 嘿嘿，师姐你看那边是谁？
column2: Hehe, Senior Sister, who is over there?

column1: 嘿嘿，眼下趁着店家不备，可以潜入库房中去。\n虽说库房内堆放的商品大多不是精品，但能免费顺走也是美事一桩啊！
column2: Hehe, we can sneak into the warehouse now that the storekeeper isn't prepared.\nThough most of the goods stored in the warehouse are not premium items, snagging them for free is still a blessing!

column1: 1. 本游戏是一款武侠题材的开放世界游戏，适用于16周岁及以上的用户，建议未成年人在家长监护下使用游戏产品。\\n\\n2. 本游戏画面为水墨风格，清新淡雅，弘扬我国美学文化。讲述了主角行侠仗义，惩奸除恶，帮助自己的门派发扬光大，造福百姓的故事。游戏中的背景皆为架空，不会与现实混淆。游戏中的玩法多为动脑的策略玩法，没有激烈刺激的战斗画面。游戏内所有内容都遵循相关法律法规。\\n\\n3. 本游戏中有用户实名认证系统，认证为未成年人的用户将接受以下管理：\\n<color=#BC1717>  〇 未满8周岁的用户不能付费购买游戏；8周岁以上的未满16周岁的未成年人用户，不得单次消费超过50元人民币，每月充值消费累计不得超过200元人民币；16周岁以上的未成年人用户，单次消费不得超过100元人民币，每月充值消费累计不得超过400元人民币。\\n  〇 本游戏仅可在周五、周六、周日和法定节假日每日20时至21时向未成年人提供1小时网络游戏服务，其他时间均不以任何形式向未成年人提供网络游戏服务。</color>\\n\\n4. 本游戏以策略玩法为主，玩家可以通过游戏内提供的资源和线索，结合自身长处变得更强，有益于玩家享受游戏乐趣，放松身心。游戏过程中，通过丰富的游戏内容，玩法和剧情等，让玩家身临其境，体会到现实生活中不一样的乐趣。帮助玩家在享受游戏乐趣进行放松与休息后，更好地投入现实中的工作与学习中。\\n
